snippet.title: Forza Horizon 6 - Pre-Order Trailer | PS5 Games
snippet.description:
https://www.playstation.com/games/forza-horizon-6/

Forza Horizon 6 comes to PlayStation 5 on January 26. Pre-order now to get a pre-tuned Ferrari J50 in-game. Play up to 5 days early and be among the first to experience the all-new Expansion on Day One with the Premium Edition.

Discover breathtaking Japan in over 550 real-world cars and become a racing Legend in Forza Horizon 6. Cruise the suburbs and iconic downtown streets of Tokyo City and explore a map full of verticality, diverse biomes and spectacular driving experiences. Japan awaits!

#ps5 #ps5games #forzahorizon6
